New York bureau: two diamonds that sparkle the same. Diamond A, a VVS1, at $14,300. Diamond B, an SI1 with small inclusions, at $8,400. Unless you carry a jeweler's loupe everywhere you go, says Osiris, the GIA-trained dealer behind the online house Osiris Diamonds, diamond B looks exactly the same on your hand and leaves $5,900 in your bank account. Clarity is the grade you pay for and cannot see.

Video: Osiris Diamonds, YouTube, 31 October 2026 (Diamond Clarity: Why One Costs $6,000 More). Prices as spoken on the tape.
